criteria.B_F: Q(ETOT)+B_TS+gamma_3*(|ETOT|+|TS|+|lambda*Tr(WP)|)+B_lambda_trace; Q is derived per source output token; B_TS=Q(TS)+|TS_logged-HP_center|+outward interval radius from raw occupation/k-weight/temperature tokens plus the checked 100/160-digit Decimal enclosure; the same occupation kernel feeds capture rows and entropy; B_trace=gamma_256*sum|W_ij P_ji|+sum|W_ij|*P_component_bound_ji; B_lambda_trace=|lambda|*B_trace+Q_lambda*(|Tr(WP)|+B_trace)
criteria.B_W: R_fine-g0; pass only when h^2 scaling resolved and abs(B_W)<=N_unc
criteria.R05: At U=J=0, require literal NOT APPLICABLE; tighten conv_thr by 10x for tight pairs and do not invent R05 thresholds.
criteria.analysis_arithmetic: Propagate gamma bounds through centered D differences/divisions, Richardson combinations, scaling differences and residual, truncation estimate, and allowance additions; include decimal-grid-to-binary h discrepancy. Round all positive bounds upward; compare B_W via exact Decimal subtraction of binary64 R_fine and g0.
criteria.h2_resolution: Approved h2-dominance rule: A=D(.005)-D(.0025), B=D(.01)-D(.005), L=(16A-B)/36, H=(B-4A)/180. Propagate uA/uB from the frozen uD and arithmetic bounds, then uL/uH through these linear combinations. Require |L|>uL and |L|-uL>16*(|H|+uH), with comparison performed on exact Decimal representations of the computed binary64 values. This replaces only the former strict 4:1 resolution check; g0, ug0, N_unc, Richardson and identity bias gate are unchanged.
criteria.ug0: abs(Tr(W1*(P_tight-P_standard))) + gamma_256*sum_ij abs(W1_ij)*(|P_standard_ji|+|P_tight_ji|) + sum_ij abs(W1_ij)*(Qcomplex(P_standard_ji)+Qcomplex(P_tight_ji)); dynamic scales/input error for both matrices

start_seed_rule: Every standard/tight and signed-lambda response copies identical accepted no-U Fe_out bytes; no continuation between response cases.
